assertions.text: Output contains a @TableTest annotation
assertions.evidence: @TableTest(""" appears 5 times in the code for different test methods

assertions.text: Multiple @TableTest methods are used, each addressing a distinct concern
assertions.evidence: 5 separate @TableTest methods: addItem, removeItem, couponApplication, checkout, calculateTotal

assertions.text: Each @TableTest has only the rows needed to express its concern's rules
assertions.evidence: addItem: 3 rows, removeItem: 4, couponApplication: 6, checkout: 5, calculateTotal: 6 — each focused

assertions.text: Item operations, coupon application, cart total, and checkout are in separate methods
assertions.evidence: addItemStoresCataloguePriceAndReturnsMessage, removeItemUpdatesCartAndReturnsMessage, couponApplicationResult, checkoutVerifiesStockAndReturnsMessage, calculateTotalAppliesDiscountFlooredAtZero

assertions.text: Each table row is independently executable — no row depends on a prior row's result
assertions.evidence: All methods build fresh Cart/state per row; e.g., 'Cart items' and 'Catalogue' supplied as inputs, not from prior row

assertions.text: Coupon application table uses before/after columns
assertions.evidence: couponApplicationResult has 'Previous active code' and 'Active code after?' columns

assertions.text: Coupon application table tests validity and replacement, not coupon type effects on price
assertions.evidence: @Description states 'Discount calculation for each coupon type is covered by calculateTotal tests'; couponApplicationResult tests validity, expiry, and replacement only

assertions.text: Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
assertions.evidence: All 5 tables have 'Scenario' as the first column

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?'
assertions.evidence: Multiple columns across tables: 'Items after?', 'Message?', 'Active code after?', 'Success?', 'Total?'

assertions.text: Scenario names describe conditions, not outcomes
assertions.evidence: 'Add to empty cart', 'New coupon replaces existing', 'Sufficient stock' — all describe input conditions, not outcomes

assertions.text: Column names use domain/business language, not code identifiers
assertions.evidence: Columns: 'Product ID', 'Qty', 'Catalogue', 'Cart items', 'Message?', 'Coupon', 'Inventory' — all business terms

assertions.text: Test method body contains no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: All 5 test method bodies contain only: build helpers, act (call service), assertAll — no if/switch

assertions.text: Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName, @Description, @TableTest
assertions.evidence: couponApplicationResult and calculateTotalAppliesDiscountFlooredAtZero use @Description then @TableTest; others use @TableTest alone

assertions.text: Test method has a clear, descriptive title
assertions.evidence: Method names: addItemStoresCataloguePriceAndReturnsMessage, removeItemUpdatesCartAndReturnsMessage, couponApplicationResult, checkoutVerifiesStockAndReturnsMessage, calculateTotalAppliesDiscountFlooredAtZero

assertions.text: If @Description is present and long, it uses a text block, not string concatenation
assertions.evidence: @Description uses triple-quoted block ("""...""") in couponApplicationResult and calculateTotalAppliesDiscountFlooredAtZero

assertions.text: Each @TableTest method has a single, uniform assertion pattern applied to all rows
assertions.evidence: All 5 methods use assertAll(...) with uniform assertions across all rows, not branching per scenario

assertions.text: Product prices and coupon rules are visible in the table or @Description
assertions.evidence: 'Catalogue' column shows prices; 'Coupon in store' encodes type/value/expiry; @Description explains coupon type behavior

assertions.text: TypeConverter methods convert map/string table values into domain objects
assertions.evidence: parseCouponStore(String) and parseCoupon(String) @TypeConverter methods; test bodies contain only arrange-act-assert

assertions.text: Coupon data is expressed in a single column with a @TypeConverter
assertions.evidence: couponApplicationResult: 'Coupon in store' column; calculateTotal: 'Coupon' column — each parsed by single @TypeConverter

assertions.text: Columns representing maps use standard TableTest map syntax [k: v, k2: v2] and [:] for empty
assertions.evidence: All tables use '[widget-1: 2]', '[widget-1: 2, gadget-2: 1]', '[:]' — standard syntax, not custom brackets

assertions.text: @Description does not repeat information that scenario names already convey
assertions.evidence: @Description in calculateTotal explains product-specific behavior and floor; scenario names ('Product-specific on target', 'Fixed amount off') already convey coupon types and examples
